propositions: changing ticket_type silently carries forward a plan-review verdict computed under different criteria, replaying stored attestation without re-evaluation

type gates scoring in plan-review orchestrator and workflow_ops across bug, session_log, code_review, and identity categories, so a plan passing as bug remains incorrectly certified when retyped to task
both reuse paths in reuse.py validate material fingerprint and code SHA but never compare stored versus current ticket_type, allowing type-incompatible verdicts to persist
the REVIEW_RESULT sidecar already records ticket_type but reuse functions never read it for the validity decision
adding ticket_type to material_fingerprint basis would invalidate all existing attestations; fail-open comparison preserves backward compatibility
